statistic.title: Nombre de médias importés par mois cette année
statistic.sql: SELECT year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) AS année, monthname(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) as mois, concat(count(DISTINCT logged_row_id)) as creation FROM `ca_change_log` cal where cal.logged_table_num=56 and changetype="I" and year(NOW()) = year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) GROUP BY année,mois ORDER BY année,month(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime))

statistic.title: Nom de médias importés par mois - année dernière
statistic.sql: SELECT year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) AS année, monthname(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) as mois, concat(count(DISTINCT logged_row_id)) as creation FROM `ca_change_log` cal where cal.logged_table_num=56 and changetype="I" and year(NOW()) - 1 = year(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime)) GROUP BY année,mois ORDER BY année,month(FROM_UNIXTIME(cal.log_datetime))
